priorFindingsDetail.FIND-004: RESOLVED — behavioral-spec.md:25-26 adds REQ-4b (skip wake on no-viable-topic/insufficient-research) and verification-architecture.md:36 adds PROP-14 testing it with a stubbed empty-research input.
priorFindingsDetail.FIND-005: RESOLVED — verification-architecture.md:35 adds PROP-13 mapped to REQ-7, T2, required:true, testing Mode-B publish-then-distribute with no human gate present.

priorFindingsDetail.FIND-009: NOT-RESOLVED — verification-architecture.md:27 (PROP-5) narrows its own claim to test only the deterministic fail-closed WIRING and explicitly disclaims responsibility for V0.5's internal rubric ('independent of V0.5's internal rubric ... See new FIND-002 (this iteration).

summary: 6 of 9 prior findings are genuinely resolved with real spec text changes (FIND-001,002,003,004,005,007). 3 prior findings (FIND-006, FIND-008, FIND-009) were resolved cosmetically: the spec text changed, but each change relocated or narrowed the scope of the underlying problem rather than closing it, so the original defect persists under a new name (documented as 5 fresh findings, FIND-001..005, in this iteration's findings/ dir). Sprint 2's entire money milestone (note rail -> V4) currently rests on an unspecified zero-human dashboard/API read (FIND-001, blocker) and an account-creation dependency REQ-11 itself admits is unproven zero-human (FIND-005). The V0.5 craft gate still has no defined rubric despite being the fail-closed publish gate for every wake (FIND-002), and its delegated brand-safety check (execution-claim detection) is absent from the REQ that defines it (FIND-003). REQ-14's newly-added 3-round retry cap has no corresponding proof obligation (FIND-004). Verdict is FAIL on both spec_fidelity and verification_readiness; the spec is not yet ready for 2a (Red) under strict mode.
